title: Uninvited U.S. Investors? Economic Consequences of Involuntary Cross-listings

requirements.description: Author-specified analysis inputs and complete construction workflow for the paper’s reported results and the supplied appendix. The appendix describes outlier-removal and matching checks, momentum-adjusted propensity matching, an “as-if” valuation analysis, and a J.P. Morgan case. It names some input source families for its valuation tables (depositary-receipt lists, CRSP files, SEC Form F-6 filings, Worldscope, and Datastream), but no data or programs are included. The package does not identify the exact author-distributed files, product/version, source fields, identifiers, complete historical coverage, construction, or full-paper stages. The named sources are not verified acquisition routes and do not establish an access barrier. Obtain author inputs/specifications; do not independently reconstruct historical sources.

issues.description: The assigned package contains only an online-appendix PDF. It has no runnable author program or entry point for the appendix or the full article workflow.

The document gives selected robustness-test descriptions and some data-source names, but no README, scripts, analysis data, software instructions, or producer-consumer sequence. It cannot establish full-paper inputs, exact source fields/coverage, data construction, acquisition/access conditions, required software, or all branches. Dependency closure remains unresolved.

actions.description: Obtain the complete author replication release or an author-approved written substitute for the missing programs and workflow, then trace all stages and dependencies.
steps: Request the author README/run instructions, entry and supporting programs or project files, required software/runtime configuration, and an explicit stage order covering the full article and appendix analyses.

After author materials are supplied, trace every required input, generated intermediate, cross-language handoff, and author-defined alternative branch; do not infer producers or acquisition steps from filenames or the appendix alone.
validation: Confirm the supplied workflow covers the main paper results and all four appendix sections, including required robustness variants.

Confirm every mandatory dependency has an identified producer or a supported acquisition route, with all intermediate consumers ordered after their producers; retain unresolved branches as explicit issues.

actions.description: Clarify which author inputs implement the paper and appendix analyses, including actual released data and their field, history, and construction specifications.
steps: Ask the authors to identify and provide the data inputs used by their programs, or their author-prepared analysis datasets if that is the released workflow, with exact filenames, product/version, formats, source columns, identifiers/merge keys, covered periods, sample restrictions, and transformations.

Use the appendix’s stated valuation measures and source families only to resolve the author workflow; do not treat the names of Worldscope, Datastream, CRSP, depositary-receipt lists, or SEC filings as verified current routes or infer a license barrier.
validation: When the code and files are available, use bounded format-aware metadata probes and compare actual source fields, IDs, periods, and sample coverage against the author code before marking any route verified.
Keep unknown source access, product history, data construction, missing fields, and baseline-paper requirements unresolved until supported by author or authoritative route evidence.

review_notes: This is a document-only appendix variant; reported table values and descriptions do not supply usable analysis datasets or runnable code. No analysis-only scope is supported. The appendix’s cited data-source names were retained as discovery context, not treated as verified acquisition routes or license barriers.
